name: Grilled Lobster
instructions: 1. Clean and split the lobsters lengthwise, removing the vein. 2. Prepare a marinade by blending grated coconut, ginger, garlic, red chili powder, turmeric, and roasted coriander seeds with a little mustard oil and lemon juice. 3. Apply the marinade generously over the lobster meat. 4. Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes. 5. Heat a grill or heavy-bottomed pan and drizzle with mustard oil. 6. Place the lobsters shell-side down and cook for 5-7 minutes. 7. Flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes until the meat turns opaque and firm. 8. Garnish with fresh curry leaves and serve hot.
description: Grilled Lobster is a celebratory dish in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, showcasing the archipelago's abundance of fresh, high-quality seafood. It reflects the fusion of traditional island coastal cooking with subtle influences from mainland Indian spice palettes, making it a highlight of the local seafood culinary scene.
